To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cross language acoustic similarity of NSD and British English vowels and the cross language perceptual similarity of Dutch vowels to British English vowels are affected by the native accents of British English listeners.

listenersa differential experience with the acoustic properties of vowels affects their perception and that this is not limited to the perception of vowels within a language but also affects the perception of other languages.
